summary: Tioga County tower erected on Maple Hill in 1921; moved to Bloss Mountain in 1939 and removed there in 1986.

facts.status_note: Moved to Bloss Mountain in 1939 and removed there in 1986; no source describes the Maple Hill site today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Bloss Mountain register page gives 1939 as the build year, but 1921 newspaper reports show the tower was erected on Maple Hill in 1921 and moved to Bloss Mountain in 1939

notes_for_editor: The brief's Maple Hill record (gone, 18.3 m, 639 m elevation) matches the sources, but the structure was moved to Bloss Mountain in 1939 and removed there in 1986, so the status note says so; the Bloss Mountain record may need its own relocation note. Height: 60 ft (1921) at Maple Hill versus 80 ft (October 1939) at Bloss Mountain; the sources do not say whether the tower was raised in the move, so the story gives both figures without explaining the change. Agency is the 1921 Pennsylvania Forestry Department; the 1939 announcement names the Department of Forests and Waters. The 1939 Lee weebly page also calls the Bloss tower the new Bloss Mt. Tower. No source describes either site today.
